section.para: In this lesson, you will learn that if we rearrange and rewrite the expression on one side of a quadratic equation to be a perfect square (that is, if we complete the square) we can find the solutions of the equation.
When you finish this lesson, you will be able to:

list.item: Explain what it means to "complete the square" and describe how to do it.
Solve quadratic equations by completing the square and finding square roots.

section.para: Here are the activities that will help you reach those goals:

list.item: 9.2.2: Standard and Factored Forms of Perfect Squares

section.para: After that, you'll practice and review.
